takeaways.text: The combined ratio worsened from 86.8% as catastrophe losses nearly tripled to $283M and reserve releases shrank — but the accident-year ratio ex-CAT held at 88.4%, so the core book is steady.
takeaways.title: Combined ratio up on storms, not slippage

takeaways.text: Net income rose 63% to $844M ($1.60/share) even as underwriting income fell 29% — fair-value investment gains and 9% higher GI investment income more than filled the gap.
takeaways.title: Investments carried GAAP profit

takeaways.text: AIG returned $787M in the quarter ($527M buybacks, $260M dividends), declared a $0.50 dividend, and grew adjusted book value per share 5% to $81.25.
takeaways.title: Capital returns continue

verdict: Underwriting got harder (storms), investments got kinder: net income up 63% with premiums growing 7%.
